Fixes an obsolete “No favorites match” warning in the UI Audit & Gallery window after favorites or picker filters change.

## Fixes

- Refresh the matching-favorite count when selection preferences change and display it before capture.
- Clear an old no-match warning when matching favorites become available, including warnings retained across script reloads.
- Prevent script reloads from creating an empty in-memory report; saved reports still reload from their report folder.

Favorite selection and filtering behavior remain the same. The reported issue was a stale warning even though five favorite devices already matched.

## Install or update

Use this Git URL in Unity Package Manager:

```text
https://github.com/dghn/editorcraft-device-simulator-tools.git#v0.3.1
```

The installer defaults to v0.3.1. Batch UI/safe-area auditing and the comparison gallery introduced in v0.3.0 remain included.

## Validation

The favorite regression probe passed in Unity **2022.3.62f2** and **6000.6.5f1**. It covers the actual picker star/save path, the five reported devices, search/platform/type filters, empty favorites, and stale-warning recovery. Native Unity gallery inspection confirmed five matching favorites with the obsolete warning cleared.

Package integrity checks and all seven installer tests pass. This patch does not claim a fresh clean Git-install test of the new tag.
